collections.name: ADK Track
collections.tagline: Build in code with Python SDK

courses.name: ADK: Foundations
courses.description: Agent fundamentals in code — what a Lyzr agent is, your first agent, swapping LLM providers, streaming, structured outputs, and a multi-provider chatbot project.

syllabus.title: What is a Lyzr Agent
syllabus.summary: What an agent really is — an LLM plus role, goal, instructions, and a run loop.

syllabus.title: Your first Agent
syllabus.summary: Create and run your first agent with create_agent and agent.run().

syllabus.title: Swapping LLM Providers
syllabus.summary: Switch between GPT, Claude, and Gemini by changing a single line.

syllabus.title: Streaming Responses
syllabus.summary: Stream tokens as they're generated instead of waiting for the full reply.

syllabus.title: Structured Outputs
syllabus.summary: Constrain output to a Pydantic schema for reliable, typed results.

syllabus.title: Project: Multi-provider chatbot
syllabus.summary: Capstone — build a chatbot that swaps providers and streams structured replies.

courses.name: ADK: Multimodal
courses.description: Multimodal agents in code — image generation, file generation, and a creative-assistant project.

syllabus.title: Image generation
syllabus.summary: Generate images from a prompt inside an agent.

syllabus.title: File generation
syllabus.summary: Have an agent produce a document or file as its output.

syllabus.title: Project: Creative assistant
syllabus.summary: Capstone — one prompt in, a hero image and a marketing PDF out.

courses.name: ADK: Knowledge & Memory
courses.description: RAG and memory in code — what RAG is, document ingestion, vector stores and retrieval, agent and conversation memory, and a document Q&A bot capstone.

syllabus.title: What is RAG?
syllabus.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation — ground answers in your own documents.

syllabus.title: Document ingestion
syllabus.summary: Load PDFs, docs, and websites into a knowledge base.

syllabus.title: Vector stores and retrieval
syllabus.summary: How embeddings and vector search surface the right chunks per query.

syllabus.title: Agent memory basics
syllabus.summary: Give an agent memory so it carries context across calls.

syllabus.title: Conversation memory
syllabus.summary: Persist the back-and-forth of a session as conversation memory.

syllabus.title: Project: Document Q&A bot
syllabus.summary: Capstone — a RAG bot that answers questions over real documents.

courses.name: ADK: Tools & Workflows
courses.description: Give agents the ability to act in code — why tools matter, writing local tools, agent context (standing knowledge in the system prompt), and multi-step workflows with a manager agent. All four lessons recorded.

syllabus.title: Why tools matter
syllabus.summary: Why a text-only agent can't query data or act — and how tools close the gap.

syllabus.title: Writing local tools
syllabus.summary: Hand an agent multiple Python-function tools and let it choose and chain them.

syllabus.title: Agent context
syllabus.summary: Standing knowledge in the system prompt via contexts=[...], added or removed between calls.

syllabus.title: Multi-step workflows
syllabus.summary: Orchestrate specialists with a manager agent via managed_agents.

courses.name: ADK: GitAgent & OSS
courses.description: Developer tooling and open source — GitAgent install, automating code reviews, OpenGAP, and contributing to Lyzr open source.

courses.name: Architect: Fundamentals
courses.description: Build full agentic apps with no code — what Architect is, designing your first agent in plain English, advanced configuration, and an enterprise agent-design walkthrough.

courses.name: Lyzr Agent Building
courses.description: Build production agents on Lyzr's AI Studio — core components, tool calling, agentic RAG, and manager orchestration — then industry deep-dives (sales, HR, banking, e-commerce, VC, insurance, marketing) and cloneable blueprints.

courses.name: Studio: Foundations (The Agent Lifecycle)
courses.description: The whole agent lifecycle on one agent — orient in Studio, then build, govern, test, deploy, and monitor a single agent end to end.

syllabus.title: Welcome to Agent Studio & the lifecycle
syllabus.summary: Tour the nav and the Build→Govern→Test→Deploy→Monitor loop.

syllabus.title: Build: choose a type & create an agent
syllabus.summary: Pick an agent type and create one from role, goal, instructions.

syllabus.title: Equip: model, tool, knowledge
syllabus.summary: Connect an LLM, attach a tool, add a knowledge base.

syllabus.title: Govern: add guardrails
syllabus.summary: Apply basic input/output guardrails before it goes anywhere.

syllabus.title: Test: run the Simulation Engine
syllabus.summary: Validate behaviour against scenarios pre-ship.

syllabus.title: Deploy: ship it
syllabus.summary: Deploy to an environment and go live.

syllabus.title: Project: one agent, full lifecycle
syllabus.summary: Carry one agent through every stage; read its first traces.

courses.name: Studio: Building & Orchestrating Agents
courses.description: Decide what to build and build it — the agent-type decision framework, building multi-agent systems with managers, custom tool calling, and models in production.

syllabus.title: What agent type should I build?
syllabus.summary: Decision framework: single Agent vs Manager vs SuperFlow vs Workflow vs Proxy vs Voice.

syllabus.title: Lyzr Manager
syllabus.summary: Coordinate sub-agents with a manager agent.

syllabus.title: Managers, part 2 — editing from the agent page
syllabus.summary: Modify sub-agents and orchestrate settings directly on the agent canvas.

syllabus.title: SuperFlow: Invoice Reconciliation
syllabus.summary: Multi-agent reconciliation pattern in practice.

syllabus.title: SuperFlow: Loops
syllabus.summary: Implement repeating patterns and iterative loops in SuperFlow.

syllabus.title: Models in depth
syllabus.summary: Providers, parameters, routing, and selection in Studio.

syllabus.title: Tools in production
syllabus.summary: Tool schemas, authentication, API integrations, and validation.

courses.name: Studio: Grounding Agents in Knowledge
courses.description: Ground agents in your data — RAG, knowledge bases, document parsing, live data connectors, agent memory, and building semantic models overlaying knowledge graphs.

syllabus.title: RAG in Studio
syllabus.summary: How retrieval-augmented generation works here.

syllabus.title: Build a Knowledge Base
syllabus.summary: Create, structure, and attach a knowledge base.

syllabus.title: Document parsing & ingestion
syllabus.summary: File types, chunking strategies, and parsing quality.

syllabus.title: Data Connectors as live sources
syllabus.summary: Keep a KB synced from external systems in real-time.

syllabus.title: Agent memory in depth
syllabus.summary: Memory types, configuration, and retrieval logic.

syllabus.title: Beyond vectors: structured knowledge
syllabus.summary: When a graph/semantic model beats plain RAG.

syllabus.title: Build a Knowledge Graph
syllabus.summary: Model entities and relationships on a graph database.

syllabus.title: The Semantic Model
syllabus.summary: Define a domain schema for grounded answers.

syllabus.title: Project: document Q&A agent with memory
syllabus.summary: End-to-end RAG + memory + structured query build.

courses.name: Studio: Governing & Testing Agents
courses.description: Make agents safe and validate before you ship — the Responsible AI safety surface, guardrails, stress testing, and the Simulation Engine.

syllabus.title: Responsible AI in Studio
syllabus.summary: The safety surface, toxicity, bias, PII handling, and prompt-injection defense.

syllabus.title: The Simulation Engine
syllabus.summary: Stress test agents against scenario suites and check evaluation metrics.

courses.name: Studio: Voice Agents
courses.description: Build agents that talk — voice architecture, telephony/SIP integrations, tuning latency, and customer-service voice agents.

courses.name: Studio: Deploy & Scale
courses.description: Ship and scale — deployment configs, environment promotion (dev/staging/prod), and the Agent Gateway.

courses.name: Studio: Monitor & Observe
courses.description: See what agents do in production — traces, transcripts, and operational reports.

courses.name: Studio: Reuse & Distribute
courses.description: Scale through reuse — agent templates, blueprints, and the Lyzr App Store.

courses.name: Lyzr Overview and Offerings
courses.description: A comprehensive walk-through of Lyzr's offerings. Learn about the 5-layer stack (Infrastructure, Integration, Framework, Studio, Architect) and explore visual Studio builders, Computer Agents, and Git-native agent harnesses.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Lyzr
syllabus.summary: Understand the challenges of scaling from simple prototypes to complex production agent lifecycles.

syllabus.title: Client Success Stories
syllabus.summary: Real-world case studies of WTW, Accenture, and KPMG implementing agent systems.

syllabus.title: The Lyzr Stack
syllabus.summary: Detailed look at the five architectural layers of the Lyzr agent platform.

syllabus.title: Architect
syllabus.summary: Using Lyzr Architect to design agent workflows and generate UI blueprints.

syllabus.title: Studio
syllabus.summary: Visual low-code agent creation, knowledge bases, and API integrations in Lyzr Studio.

syllabus.title: Lyzr Capabilities
syllabus.summary: PII redaction, toxicity filters, prompt safety, hallucination checks, and RAG/Knowledge Graph integrations.

syllabus.title: Computer Agent
syllabus.summary: Importing custom agents from Git repos and running them in your own harness.

syllabus.title: Git Agent
syllabus.summary: Understanding Git-native multimodal agent harnesses defined entirely by repository files.
